entity_raw.definition_raw: Revolution SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): LiberationAssociated Deities: Anogetz, Black Butterfly, Desna, Falayna, Khepri, Milani, Sun Wukong, Taraksun, Vevelor, XhasnapharReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the freedom’s call power of the Liberation domain. Powerful Persuader (Su): At 8th level, when you make a Diplomacy or Intimidate check, you can roll twice and take the higher result. Using this ability is a free action. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, plus one additional time per day for every 2 levels beyond 8th.Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—enthrall, 6th—symbol of persuasion.
